In Hokkaido, using the Yufutsu LNG receiving terminal, it also provides LNG satellite supply by tank lorry and wheeling supply services. It sells electricity by entrusting power generation to the affiliate Fukushima Gas Hatsuden, and also works on renewable energy such as biomass power generation and on storage battery business.

entries.b9d51fda33d8fc97: Explores, develops and produces crude oil and natural gas in Japan, and sells natural gas, LNG and electricity. It operates a gas pipeline network and delivers gas to customers along the pipeline, and also manufactures and sells petroleum products and undertakes contracted well drilling work. This is the reportable segment with the largest revenue from external customers.
entries.ba2993ff422e00b4: The consolidated subsidiary JAPEX Norge AS engages in exploration, development and production of crude oil and natural gas in blocks in Norway's territorial waters. In July 2024, the company acquired the shares of that subsidiary.
entries.cd659867f9a15ad2: It cites as strengths its overall E&P technical capability, including exploration, physical exploration and reservoir technologies developed in Japan's geologically difficult conditions, its CCUS track record and expertise, which rank first in Japan, and strict portfolio management.
entries.d2802420e85a3353: In April 2026, it published the JAPEX Management Plan 2026-2035. It positions fiscal 2026 to fiscal 2030 as a period to concentrate on overseas E&P and CCUS to build a 'core asset base', and fiscal 2031 to fiscal 2035 as a period when contributions to earnings begin in earnest. It aims for net income to grow to ¥100 billion in fiscal 2035.
